messages:
alyssa: Heads up — getting a customer escalation for lots of 502s hitting Hosted API after the auth-service deploy at 14:05 UTC. @mike can you eyeball?
deploy-bot: deploy auth-service v2.8.4 -> prod started by ci-pipeline (14:03 UTC)
alyssa: Error pattern: spike in 502 and upstream premature close, mostly for streaming/generation requests. Customers see failures ~200-400 req/s for a 10m window.
mike: On it. any quick traces or trace ids from customers?
alyssa: Pasted one trace header from customer: trace-id=1a2b3c4d; request-id=rid-9427. Stack shows Envoy: "upstream connection closed before response completed" and nginx upstream: "recv() failed (104: Connection reset by peer)"
jen: I pulled ingress metrics — TCP resets and 502 rate align exactly with the deploy window and the ingress rolling update for auth pods. Liveness probes failing briefly during drain.
ben: Repro attempt: `ab -n 1000 -c 20` against /v1/generate while doing a rolling restart of auth. I see 5-10% 502s during drain when concurrent streams are open.
luis-sre: Likely cause: auth-service started returning early 503s during graceful shutdown which translated to upstream resets at Envoy. Also saw short DNS flapping for auth svc during the rollout (kube-proxy conn churn).
mike: Can we quickly mitigate for customer? Options: rollback to previous revision, pause rollout, bump ingress connection pool and drain timeout. Which is least disruptive?
alyssa: Customer prefers minimal change. Suggest increasing ingress upstream_timeout and temporarily disabling rolling restarts — hold the deploy and scale up new pods behind a fixed LB.
jen: Implemented short mitigation at 14:11 UTC: increased envoy upstream_idle_timeout and increased `max_connections` on nginx upstream from 1000 -> 2000. Also set pod terminationGracePeriodSeconds=45 to give streams time to finish.
ben: After mitigation metrics: 502s dropped to baseline within ~90s. I still see a tail of 1-2% until all pods probe ok.
luis-sre: Root cause hypothesis: combination of auth pod drain timeout too short + connection window collision with long-lived streaming tokens -> upstream connection resets when backend closed while envoy still streaming. Also transient DNS flaps during kube rolling updates amplified errors.
mike: Repro steps documented for runbook: 1) start streaming request; 2) trigger rolling restart on auth; 3) monitor envoy logs for `upstream connection closed` and nginx `recv() failed (104)`; 4) verify increase in resets.
alyssa: Customer update sent at 14:20 UTC — mitigation applied, errors subsided, follow-up plan shared.
jen: Follow-ups: (a) increase default pod terminationGracePeriodSeconds for streaming services, (b) add preStop hook to drain active streaming connections gracefully, (c) make DNS client backoff more tolerant during rollouts, (d) add a canary flag to pause auth rollouts if ingress error rate > 1%.
ben: Adding watch dashboard for long-lived streams + pod drain overlap.
mike: Filing infra ticket INF-5492 for config changes and SRE playbook update.
alyssa: Thanks team. I'll keep the customer looped. Close here when tickets are in triage. :thumbsup:
